title: "RAPORT"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
dane <- read.csv("StudentPerformanceFactors.csv")
View(dane)

for (kolumna in names(dane)) {
  if (is.character(dane[[kolumna]])) {
    puste <- grepl("^[\\h\\v]*$", dane[[kolumna]], perl = TRUE)
    dane[[kolumna]][puste] <- NA_character_
  }
}

colSums(is.na(dane))
naniar::gg_miss_var(dane)

gg_miss_var(dane)
```

```{R}
vis_miss(dane)

gg_miss_fct(x=dane, fct = Gender)
```
